en: We were crowned in laurels of white， and delivered to the Skyborn's palace in the heavens.
zh: 我们戴上洁白的桂冠，被迎入云端的天界人宫殿。

en: From there， far above the coils of clouds that held blue sky to green earth， we gazed down at the world as the sun fled over the horizon.
zh: 云海将蓝天与绿野相连，我们立于云端之上，俯瞰夕阳渐落的世界。

en: How could war be waged in so perfect a place? It seemed impossible， like a dream.
zh: 如此完美的地方，怎会燃起战火？一切恍若梦境，令人难以置信。

en: Our battle was over.
zh: 我们的战斗结束了。

en: But down below， another struggle was beginning.
zh: 可大地上，另一场斗争才刚刚开始。

en: Would humanity prove themselves worthy of the Second Age we had won? We watched， and waited...
zh: 人类能否配得上我们赢来的第二纪元？我们静静注视，等待着……

en: There was a flash of light， and then a voice cut through the haze， beckoning us.
zh: 一道光芒闪过，接着，一个声音穿透迷雾，呼唤着我们。

en: When we awoke， we found ourselves on human soil. By our side was the black knight， whose cause we now knew was joined with ours.
zh: 醒来时，我们已回到人类的土地。黑骑士站在身旁，如今我们明白，他与我们志向相同。

en: How strange to think the Earthblood's conqueror， the old man we'd seen as our greatest adversary， might have just saved our lives.
zh: 真是不可思议。那个征服了地界人、曾被我们视为头号强敌的老人，或许刚救了我们的命。

en: And that his actions， which we once condemned， now bore the tint of justice.
zh: 就连他那些曾被我们唾弃的所作所为，如今也染上了几分正义的色彩。

en: Had we done right for the world?
zh: 我们真的为这个世界做了正确的事吗？

en: We had set it free-- but also， cut it loose.
zh: 我们给了它自由，却也斩断了它的依靠。

en: Nothing to tether us， or keep us safe.
zh: 再没有什么束缚我们，也再没有什么庇护我们。

en: Our strength as a race would now be tested in new ways.
zh: 人类这个种族的力量，即将迎来全新的考验。

en: We vowed to face that challenge unflinching.
zh: 我们发誓，绝不退缩。

en: Our victory would mean something... It had to.
zh: 我们的胜利一定要有意义……必须如此。

en: We had slain any who dared stand against us.
zh: 凡敢阻挡我们的人，都已死在我们手中。

en: Had all this killing somehow subtracted from the righteousness of our cause?
zh: 这些杀戮，是否也让我们的正义蒙上了阴影？

en: We chose not to regret.
zh: 我们选择不去后悔。

en: It seemed more fitting to honor the lives we had taken...
zh: 比起懊悔，更应当告慰那些逝去的生命……

en: by building a bright future in their name.
zh: 以他们之名，创造光明的未来。

en: What strength humankind possesses!
zh: 人类竟有如此强大的力量！

en: We chose to bow to the workings of the universe， saw them as immutable-- but you broke that mold and severed the chains that bind us.
zh: 我们曾顺从宇宙的法则，认定它不可改变……而你们打破了常规，斩断了束缚我们的锁链。

en: For your courage， I will deliver you back to human soil.
zh: 为嘉奖你们的勇气，我会送你们回到人类的土地。

en: But know this: peace is not yours yet.
zh: 但要记住：和平尚未降临。

en: He will find a new champion; perhaps he may even champion himself.
zh: 他会另选代行者，甚至可能亲自出手。

en: And it will fall to you to face him.
zh: 到那时，仍须由你们迎战。

en: We swear to lend you our strength when that hour comes.
zh: 我们发誓，届时必将助你们一臂之力。

en: Together， we will keep this world you have won safe from his whims.
zh: 我们将共同守护你们赢来的世界，不再任他摆布。

en: But remember: power alone will not bring you peace.
zh: 但切记：单凭力量，换不来和平。

en: Nor will anyone follow you into a future bought with blood.
zh: 用鲜血换来的未来，也不会有人追随。

en: This， I can tell you from experience.
zh: 这一点，我深有体会。

en: If you choose to rule the world in the same way you saved it， then I fear one day you and I must clash.
zh: 若你们打算用拯救世界的方式来统治世界，恐怕你我终有一战。

en: For all our sakes， let us pray that day never comes.
zh: 为了所有人，但愿那一天永远不会到来。

en: The royal knights are coming!
zh: 王国骑士来了！

en: You have to go. Now!
zh: 快走！马上！

en: Protect that sword!
zh: 保护好那把剑！

en: Uh， 'scuse me? Who are you?
zh: 呃，打扰一下？你是谁？

en: Where did SHE come from?
zh: 这女人从哪儿冒出来的？

en: Er， the ladies' room is down the hall， miss.
zh: 呃，小姐，女厕在走廊那头。

en: Dang... Ever heard of knocking?
zh: 啧……不知道先敲门吗？

en: Okay， this is starting to get weird.
zh: 好吧，事情开始不对劲了。

en: You heard the young lady. To the balcony!
zh: 没听见这位小姐的话吗？去阳台！

en: How many men did he...!? That's the sword， no mistake.
zh: 他到底干掉了多少人……！？没错，就是那把剑。

en: Time to make a quick exit， and look cool doing it.
zh: 该潇洒地闪人了。

en: Gonna have to jump. Urp... What floor are we on again?
zh: 看来只能跳了。呃……这是几楼来着？

en: A true gentleman brings the fight outdoors.
zh: 真正的绅士，打架都去屋外。

en: Hey， tell the innkeeper that THIS SHOW ROCKS!
zh: 喂，替我告诉老板：这场表演棒极了！

en: I'll explain later， just--
zh: 待会儿再解释，先——

en: Ugh， there goes my evening.
zh: 唉，今晚算是泡汤了。

en: But what business could the king's men have with us?
zh: 可国王的人找我们做什么？

en: What? I don't even...
zh: 什么？我都还没……

en: Those knights look like they mean business.
zh: 那些骑士看着可不是来闹着玩的。

en: The only way out of here is down!
zh: 想出去，就只能往下跳了！

en: But what if it's room service?
zh: 万一是客房服务呢？

en: All these soldiers... That sword MUST be the one.
zh: 出动了这么多士兵……那一定就是传说之剑。

en: You punks owe me for room and board!
zh: 你们几个混小子还欠我房钱饭钱呢！

en: Oh crap. Look at the inn! I smell a lawsuit...
zh: 糟了，旅馆都成那样了！怕是要吃官司……

en: The heat is on. Which means... I had best be off!
zh: 火烧眉毛了。这就意味着……我得开溜！

en: Is that satin I smell burning?
zh: 怎么闻着像是缎子烧起来了？

en: You were right， Randy! The Sword of Legend WASN'T just a fairy tale.
zh: 兰迪，你说得对！传说之剑还真不是童话。

en: Doesn't seem all that-- HYAH!--special， though.
zh: 不过感觉也没——嘿呀！——什么特别的嘛。

en: Wh-Whoa! Han， be careful!
zh: 哇、哇！哈恩，小心点！

en: That's centuries old! What if it's fragile?
zh: 这可是几百年前的东西！弄坏了怎么办？

en: Bah! A sword that breaks is like a dog that meows.
zh: 呸！会断的剑，就跟会喵喵叫的狗一样荒唐。

en: Um， what? A-Anyway， there's no proof we've even got the right sword yet.
zh: 呃，什么？总、总之，还不能确定我们找对了剑。

en: You know how to find out? Go stab us some DINNER.
zh: 知道怎么确认吗？拿它给咱们扎点晚饭回来。

en: I've got legendary hunger.
zh: 我都饿成传说了。

en: Um， how are we supposed to outrun an army!?
zh: 呃，我们怎么跑得过一整支军队啊！？

en: Split up. A hundred kittens bite harder than one lion!
zh: 分头跑！一百只小猫咬起来，总比一头狮子狠！

en: It's the sword they want.
zh: 他们要的是剑。

en: But we WORKED for that sword!
zh: 可这剑是我们辛苦找来的！

en: We can discuss it later. Just run! Meet you at the cemetery outside of town.
zh: 以后再说，快跑！在城外墓地会合。

en: Valgar.
zh: 瓦尔加。

en: You wound me， Serena.
zh: 瑟蕾娜，你真让我伤心。

en: How could the captain of the Red Order betray her fellow knights?
zh: 红之骑士团的团长，怎能背叛自己的同袍？

en: Did you feel unloved?
zh: 是觉得没人疼你吗？

en: I won't let you have the sword.
zh: 我不会把剑交给你。

en: No?
zh: 是吗？

en: Then die in disgrace!
zh: 那就背负着耻辱去死吧！

en: Damn their iron deviltry!
zh: 该死的铁疙瘩！

en: Pfft. “Sword of Legend“? This cuts like a butter knife!
zh: 嘁，什么“传说之剑”？连切黄油都费劲！

en: How unfair is this!?
zh: 这也太不公平了吧！？

en: So， Death wears metal robes.
zh: 原来死神披的是铁袍。

en: No fair!
zh: 耍赖！

en: What did we ever do to you?
zh: 我们到底哪里惹到你们了？

en: Stand back， guys! It's time I took this Sword of Legend through the motions!
zh: 大家退后！该让我试试这把传说之剑了！

en: Oww! What the... What gives?
zh: 哎哟！什么……搞什么啊？

en: Hey! Whose side is he on?
zh: 喂！他到底是哪边的？

en: Stop it!
zh: 住手！

en: He... he stopped. Wait a second...
zh: 他……停下了。等一下……

en: You think he has to obey us?
zh: 难道他必须听我们的话？

en: This is incredible.
zh: 真是难以置信。

en: An undead hero， returned to light our darkened world.
zh: 不死英雄归来，要为这黑暗的世界带来光明。

en: Perhaps it is time you shed a little light of your own.
zh: 或许你也该把真相说清楚了。

en: Holy schnitzel! Where'd they get that big golden freak!?
zh: 我的老天！他们从哪儿弄来这么个金灿灿的大怪物！？

en: Rrgh! Kill them swiftly， my pretties! My reputation isn't getting any more reputable!
zh: 可恶！宝贝们，快杀了他们！我的名声可经不起再折腾了！

en: The answers can wait. Let's give our new ally a command!
zh: 有话待会儿再说。先给这位新伙伴下个命令！

en: How d-d-dare you! No one drags Lord Zur's face through the mud and lives to--
zh: 你、你、你们好大的胆子！敢让祖尔大人颜面扫地的人，从来没一个能活——

en: Nyaah! What NOW?
zh: 呀啊！这回又怎么了？

en: Skeletons!? Eek!
zh: 骷髅！？呀！

en: The sword--it's raising a whole army! Will they not serve its cause?
zh: 那把剑……唤醒了一整支军队！难道他们也会听从它的号令？

en: Great， now the dead walk? This warrior sure knows how to liven up a cemetery.
zh: 好家伙，死人都起来散步了？这战士还真能让墓地热闹起来。

en: But that armor... Wouldn't royal knights have been interred by the castle?
zh: 可那身铠甲……王国骑士不该葬在城堡附近吗？

en: Looks like our golden child is waking up more corpses.
zh: 看来咱们这位金大个儿又叫醒了更多尸体。

en: But what are royal knights doing buried in a commoners' cemetery?
zh: 可王国骑士怎么会埋在平民墓地里？

en: This warrior's power seems to be resonating with the town's cemetery.
zh: 这位战士的力量，似乎与镇上的墓地产生了共鸣。

en: A strange thing， though， that these “townsfolk“ are clad in royal armor.
zh: 奇怪的是，这些“镇民”竟穿着王国骑士的铠甲。

en: Sweet!
zh: 厉害啊！

en: Not even I can raise the dead!
zh: 连我都没法让死人复活！

en: Wait， who buries commoners with swords and armor?
zh: 等等，谁会给平民陪葬刀剑铠甲啊？

en: Hey! This is not cool!
zh: 喂！这可不好玩！

en: I didn't sign up to fight a legion of stinky dead things!
zh: 我可没答应要跟一大群臭烘烘的死人打架！

en: No wonder Kanon insisted the Black Order and I accompany you.
zh: 难怪卡农坚持让我和黑之骑士团陪你来。

en: Stealing swords is a thug's job， but a blade that awakens an undead menace?
zh: 偷剑不过是地痞的活儿，可这剑竟能唤醒不死怪物？

en: That's my line of work.
zh: 这才是我的差事。

en: Step aside， Zur.
zh: 让开，祖尔。

en: Heck no! This is my chance to look good...er than I always do!
zh: 休想！这可是让我更加……英明神武的大好机会！

en: You， sir， are an assistant. Ahem! Stress on those first three letters.
zh: 先生，你只是个副手。咳！重点是那个“副”字。

en: Have it your way.
zh: 随你的便。

en: Now， my pretties! Fetch me that sword， or it's worm-gut porridge for a week!
zh: 来吧，宝贝们！给我夺下那把剑，不然就连吃一星期蛆肠粥！

en: Truly impressive.
zh: 真是了不起。

en: But I， Lord Zur， will prevail! ...Right after these messages.
zh: 但我祖尔大人终将获胜！……先插播一段广告。

en: Looks like the Sword of Legend already had an owner.
zh: 看来这把传说之剑早就有主人了。

en: I believed we were searching for the Muramasa.
zh: 我以为我们要找的是村正。

en: What blade is this?
zh: 这到底是什么剑？

en: My belief is that this sword belonged to a great hero in ages past. The forces of darkness feared its baneful bite--but I never dreamed it had the power to resurrect its former master.
zh: 我想，这把剑属于远古的一位伟大英雄。黑暗势力畏惧它的锋芒……可我从未想到，它竟能让昔日的主人复活。

en: For centuries， the royal line who sit the throne have tried to find this weapon.
zh: 几百年来，坐在王座上的王室一直在寻找这把武器。

en: Now I understand why. This warrior is capable of ending their wicked reign!
zh: 现在我明白了。这个战士有能力终结他们的暴政！

en: I will admit， the people tire of the crown's attempts to force magic down their throats.
zh: 我承认，百姓早就受够了王室强迫大家使用魔法。

en: But none of us are fools enough to revolt!
zh: 可我们又不傻，才不会造反！

en: This should have been my battle. Not yours.
zh: 这本该是我的战斗，不该把你们卷进来。

en: But neither did I expect to be so doggedly pursued. Alone， I will not last till dawn. Sadly， neither will you.
zh: 但我也没料到，他们会如此穷追不舍。我独自一人，撑不到天亮。遗憾的是，你们也一样。

en: If it's a reward you expect for finding the sword， then prepare to fill your wallets with blood and misery.
zh: 若你们还指望凭找到宝剑领赏，就准备好用鲜血与苦难装满钱袋吧。

en: You are enemies of the throne. If you want to live， we must leave here at once.
zh: 你们已经是王室的敌人。想活命，就得立刻离开。

en: My teacher lives in the wildwood. (And he's gonna tan my hide when he finds out about this.)
zh: 我师父住在野林里。（他知道这事后，肯定要扒了我的皮。）

en: Enemies， shmenemies. We've got a friggin' undead warrior! What's the problem?
zh: 敌人就敌人呗。咱们可有个不死战士！怕什么？

en: The soldiers assembled in that village plan to rebel against the kingdom. Perhaps they will aid us.
zh: 那个村子里集结的士兵正打算反抗王国。他们也许能帮助我们。

en: No wonder Kanon insisted the Black Order and I help investigate.
zh: 难怪卡农坚持要我和黑之骑士团帮忙调查。

en: Stealing swords is a job for a thug like Zur， but a blade that awakens an undead menace?
zh: 偷剑是祖尔那种地痞干的事，可这剑竟能唤醒不死怪物？

en: Poor fools. You should have stayed home today.
zh: 可怜的蠢货。今天你们就该老老实实待在家里。

en: Rabble! A sharp blade only serves a sharp mind.
zh: 乌合之众！利刃只配交给有头脑的人。

en: I fight to save our land， not for glory or riches.
zh: 我为拯救这片土地而战，不为名利。

en: I'll be on my way now， if you feel sufficiently bloodied.
zh: 若你们的血流够了，我就告辞了。

en: Nice， let me shake your-- Wait， which piece is your hand?
zh: 不错，握个手吧——等等，你的手是哪一块？

en: Sorry we crashed your party and broke all your bones. It happens.
zh: 抱歉，砸了你们的场子，还打碎了你们的骨头。常有的事。

en: Do I look like I have time for this?
zh: 看我像是有空陪你们玩吗？

en: There， had your fun? I'm out of here.
zh: 怎么样，玩够了？我走了。

en: Had enough Randy Fu?
zh: 见识够兰迪功夫了吗？

en: Where did you train， in a barn?
zh: 你的功夫是在猪圈里练的吗？

en: What， did we take a take a wrong turn? Other way， guys!
zh: 怎么，走错路了？伙计们，走另一边！

en: Stop distracting me! I'm gonna forget the plot!
zh: 别再分我的心了！剧情都快记不住了！

en: Well done， friend. I think you nearly scratched me.
zh: 打得不错，朋友。差点就划到我了。

en: Your deaths shall be bricks in the great wall of hope.
zh: 你们的尸骨，将成为希望长城的砖石。

en: Apologies， warriors， but I have no time to waste.
zh: 抱歉，各位战士，我没空耽搁。

en: I have a long road ahead， but please， feel free to play amongst yourselves.
zh: 我还有很长的路要走，你们尽管自己玩吧。

en: Omigosh! How'd I do that?
zh: 天哪！我怎么做到的？

en: Potty break!
zh: 我要上厕所啦！

en: Sorry， Nicoley's got to save the world. Next time， okay?
zh: 抱歉啦，小妮可得去拯救世界。下次再玩，好吗？

en: Sorry， I know you can't help it， but you're REALLY boring.
zh: 抱歉，我知道这不能怪你，可你实在太无聊啦。

en: This “monster“ looks just like Randy's familiar!
zh: 这只“怪物”跟兰迪的使魔一模一样！

en: Then you must be his teacher.
zh: 那么，你一定就是他的老师。

en: Down， bunny! Geez， Randy's familiar never acts this crazy.
zh: 兔子，趴下！真是的，兰迪的使魔可没这么疯。

en: Are you his teacher?
zh: 你是他的老师吗？

en: Teach? Is that you? Tell Mid to chill out!
zh: 师父？是你吗？快让米德冷静点！

en: What kind of familiar attacks people he KNOWS?
zh: 哪有使魔连认识的人都打的？

en: What manner of trickery...
zh: 这是何种妖术……

en: Hmm， this lethal lepus looks very familiar. Do you know a boy named Randy?
zh: 嗯，这只凶兔看着颇为眼熟。你可认识一个叫兰迪的少年？

en: Hey， little guy! You look just like Nando!
zh: 嘿，小家伙！你长得跟南多一模一样！

en: So the teacher Randy always talks about--I guess that must be you.
zh: 兰迪总挂在嘴边的师父……应该就是你吧。

en: Indeed. I taught Randy what spells he knows. But， for all his eagerness， I fear he's still a bit green.
zh: 不错，兰迪的法术都是我教的。只是他虽有热情，火候却还差得远。

en: I hope you will accept my apology for Mid's behavior. He's quite protective.
zh: 米德失礼了，还望见谅。他护主心切。

en: Why hello there， Randy. Back for more magical instruction? Or is little Nando giving you trouble?
zh: 哟，兰迪，你好啊。又来学法术？还是小南多给你惹麻烦了？

en: Indeed. I taught Randy what spells he knows. I can see you sling a bit of white magic yourself.
zh: 不错，兰迪的法术都是我教的。看得出，你也会几手白魔法。

en: It's us who owe an apology. The king's men are out for blood， and now we have brought them to your doorstep.
zh: 该道歉的是我们。国王的人要取我们性命，现在我们把他们引到您家门口了。

en: We didn't think ahead. We've been so busy running from the royal knights...
zh: 我们没想那么多，一直忙着躲王国骑士……

en: Hey， MY rabbit behaves! Look， Teach， we really need your help. I kind of， um， went looking for that sword we talked about.
zh: 喂，我的兔子可乖了！师父，我们真的需要你帮忙。我那个……去找了咱们说过的那把剑。

en: And now we're， um， fugitives， wanted by the kingdom... Oops?
zh: 结果现在，呃，我们成了王国通缉的逃犯……哎呀？

en: A good thing， that.
zh: 那倒是件好事。

en: I fear you may need his protection again very soon.
zh: 恐怕很快，你们又得靠他来保护了。

en: We're sorry， too... that RANDY DIDN'T TELL US!
zh: 我们也很抱歉……都怪兰迪根本没告诉我们！

en: So， you found the sword. Kanon the Grey will stop at nothing to retrieve it. You've brought great danger upon yourselves.
zh: 这么说，你们找到了那把剑。灰袍卡农会不惜一切把它夺回。你们惹上大麻烦了。

en: I suppose that deathly warrior over there is somehow connected to all of this? Come， we must find a safer place to discuss this.
zh: 那边那位死气沉沉的战士，想必也与此事有关？来，我们得找个安全的地方详谈。

en: Sorry， these bushes are taken.
zh: 抱歉，这丛灌木已经有人了。

en: A mage? Now why would you be cowering in the wildwood? Unless you've been naughty.
zh: 魔法师？怎么躲到野林里来了？莫不是干了什么坏事？

en: Take him away!
zh: 把他带走！

en: You've threatened my kingdom. These crimes must be punished.
zh: 你们威胁了我的王国。这些罪行必须受到惩罚。

en: Right now!
zh: 就在现在！

en: No， Prince Valgar. Don't soil your blades for these rabble.
zh: 不，瓦尔加王子。别让这些贱民脏了你的剑。

en: Let the Red Order handle this.
zh: 交给红之骑士团吧。

en: You and I can watch from afar， love. Wouldn't want you to get hit by flying bodies.
zh: 亲爱的，你我在远处看着就好。可别让飞来的尸体砸到你。

en: Well? Kill them!
zh: 还等什么？杀了他们！

en: When I said， “Kill them!“ I was talking to MY men! Rrgh!
zh: 我说“杀了他们”，是对我的人说的！可恶！

en: Serena captained a soft band of knights， but I will break them--after I break you.
zh: 瑟蕾娜带出来的骑士都软弱不堪。我会好好调教他们……先收拾了你再说。

en: The king's wrath is wakened. We've already bled that rebel village trying to find you. How many more must die?
zh: 国王已经震怒。为了找你们，我们已血洗了那个反叛村庄。还想让多少人送命？

en: No one will ever harbor you. Just surrender!
zh: 没人敢收留你们。乖乖投降吧！

en: Prince Valgar， stand aside.
zh: 瓦尔加王子，让开。

en: Let the Red Knight spill blood.
zh: 让红骑士来见血吧。

en: Katrina!
zh: 卡特莉娜！

en: Going to kill me， boy? Then do it.
zh: 小子，想杀我？那就动手。

en: If you truly believe murder is royal behavior.
zh: 如果你真觉得，滥杀才是王族的风范。

en: Rrgh...
zh: 可恶……

en: You've stirred up more than that warrior now.
zh: 这回你们惊动的，可不止那位战士。

en: Kanon will redouble his efforts to capture you.
zh: 卡农会加倍追捕你们。

en: He'll unleash his sorcery and metal golems upon the land--
zh: 他会将魔法和钢铁魔像倾泻到这片土地上——

en: I will never let that happen! I have already sworn to bring his tyranny to an end.
zh: 我绝不允许！我早已发誓，要终结他的暴政。

en: Hey! He may have power， but we've got the sword and three hundred pounds of undead fury. I think we can take him.
zh: 嘿！他是厉害，可我们有宝剑，还有三百磅重的不死怒火。我看打得赢。

en: Don't say any more， Teach. I messed up bad， didn't I?
zh: 别说了，师父。我这回闯大祸了，对吧？

en: And this isn't like the time I lit your hair on fire...
zh: 跟上次烧着你头发可不是一回事……

en: We'll stop Kanon. I promise. Magic should be a choice， not royal policy.
zh: 我们一定会阻止卡农，我保证。魔法该由人自己选择，不该是王国的强制法令。

en: When war casts shadows upon my fields， it is my feet I plant.
zh: 战火的阴影笼罩田野时，我便挺身而立。

en: Yes--feet of defiance! I swear to make a stand against Kanon!
zh: 不错，双脚扎根，绝不屈服！我发誓与卡农抗争到底！

en: Relax. When life hands you lemons， make some apple juice! Me and Gin'll take Kanon down.
zh: 放轻松。人生给你柠檬，你就榨杯苹果汁！我和银次郎会摆平卡农的。

en: Very well.
zh: 好吧。

en: Our land does need a savior. I shall pray you are up to the task.
zh: 这片土地确实需要救星。愿你们有能力担起这个重任。

en: Something else is troubling me. Has that black knight not heard the truth from his father? That their bloodline are not true royalty?
zh: 还有一件事让我在意。那个黑骑士，难道没从父亲那里听说真相？他们这一脉，并非真正的王族。

en: Don't be absurd!
zh: 别开玩笑了！

en: What puppet is so blind as to not see his strings?
zh: 哪有傀儡瞎到连自己的提线都看不见？

en: He's a willing participant.
zh: 他是心甘情愿的帮凶。

en: If not， how could he go around murdering innocents?
zh: 否则，怎会四处残杀无辜？

en: How could he burn farmland to ashes and starve his fellow man? Even if he doesn't know he's a puppet， he still let himself become one. He is guilty!
zh: 怎会焚毁农田，让同胞挨饿？就算不知道自己是傀儡，也是他亲手把自己变成傀儡的。他有罪！

en: Whoa whoa， time out. The king's not a king!?
zh: 等等，暂停！国王不是国王！？

en: He's got a crown， don't he?
zh: 他不是戴着王冠吗？

en: Wait! You're saying somebody just swapped a new king in?
zh: 等等！你是说，有人偷偷换了个国王？

en: But that's ridiculous! The people would never let that happen... right?
zh: 可这也太荒唐了！百姓怎么会答应……对吧？

en: A puppet monarchy?
zh: 傀儡王室？

en: Then all these radical policies--who devised them if not the king!?
zh: 那这些激进的政令……不是国王的话，又是谁定的！？

en: Not true royalty? You mean...
zh: 不是真正的王族？你是说……

en: I pay taxes to a FRAUD?
zh: 我一直在给骗子交税？

en: Calm down. You must learn to see more than the truth that is right in front of you.
zh: 冷静些。你们要学会看清眼前表象背后的真相。

en: Not so fast， love!
zh: 别急着走呀，亲爱的！

en: Sorry， Prince Valgar. She's mine!
zh: 抱歉了，瓦尔加王子。她是我的！

en: You left us， Serena. I'll peel that armor from your corpse.
zh: 瑟蕾娜，你抛下了我们。我要从你的尸体上剥下这身铠甲。

en: Knights of the Red Order! Greet your former captain.
zh: 红之骑士团的各位！向你们的前团长问个好。

en: Ha! Who trained those wimps? Oh， that's right...
zh: 哈！是谁教出了这群废物？哦，对了……

en: It was YOU.
zh: 是你啊。

en: The king's wrath is wakened.
zh: 国王已经震怒。

en: We've already bled that rebel village trying to find you. How many more must die?
zh: 为了找你们，我们已血洗了那个反叛村庄。还想让多少人送命？

en: Come， Serena， let us embrace! I must thank you for making me captain!
zh: 来吧，瑟蕾娜，拥抱一下！我得谢谢你让我当上了团长！

en: Run， Lord Kanon!
zh: 卡农大人，快跑！

en: They are a force of nature!
zh: 他们简直势不可挡！

en: The black wizard is here!?
zh: 黑魔法师在这里！？

en: There's only room for one
zh: 这里容得下的卡农，

en: “cannon“ here， and it's me!
zh: 只有我这一门大炮！

en: Did he just say “Kanon“?
zh: 他刚才说“卡农”了？

en: Kanon the Grey serves the royal family!
zh: 灰袍卡农可是为王室效力的！

en: The king's top advisor... I wonder if he takes advice as poorly as he gives it.
zh: 国王的首席顾问……不知道他听取建议，是不是也跟出主意一样差劲。

en: No mage faces the black wizard and lives! I'll， uh... I'll be standing by the door， guys.
zh: 没人能在面对黑魔法师后活下来！我，呃……我就守在门边了，伙计们。

en: Stand your ground， cowards!
zh: 守住阵地，懦夫！

en: Ah， Serena.
zh: 啊，瑟蕾娜。

en: Hoping to captain the Red Order again? You know， most traitors have the good sense not to return.
zh: 想回来继续当红之骑士团团长？要知道，大多数叛徒都识趣，不会自投罗网。

en: You know full well why I have returned.
zh: 你很清楚我为何回来。

en: Ha ha ha ha!
zh: 哈哈哈哈！

en: Do I?
zh: 是吗？

en: I thought you would take shelter with the resistance. My mistake. I should have kept more soldiers here.
zh: 我以为你会投奔反抗军。失算了，早该多留些士兵在这里。

en: Still， I suppose a pile of dead rebels and their families does make a statement.
zh: 不过，一堆死去的叛军和他们的家人，想必也足够表明我的态度了。

en: Now， your turn. Meet Silver， your executioner!
zh: 现在轮到你了。见见希尔弗，你的刽子手！

en: Die， you impostor!
zh: 去死吧，篡位的骗子！

en: You destroyed the royal family and replaced them with pawns who forced magic on my people!
zh: 你灭了真正的王室，又扶植傀儡，强迫我的人民使用魔法！

en: Ha ha ha ha! Cracked a few history books， have we? Speaking of impostors...
zh: 哈哈哈哈！翻了几本史书，是吧？说起骗子……

en: You posed as a knight and moved up the ranks just to steal information about the sword. Liar liar， Serena.
zh: 你伪装成骑士，一路爬上高位，只为窃取宝剑的情报。瑟蕾娜，你可真会骗人。

en: Whoa， time out! Is that true?
zh: 等等，暂停！这是真的？

en: The royal family's a fake?
zh: 王室是假的？

en: Yes， well， this has all been very enlightening， but in the end， I still hold power.
zh: 是，是，大家都长了不少见识。不过说到底，权力仍在我手里。

en: Here， why don't you and my pets frolic a bit while I deal with important affairs?
zh: 这样吧，你们陪我的宠物好好玩玩，我去处理要事。

en: Without these mechs， the castle will be vulnerable.
zh: 这些机甲被毁，城堡就失去了防守。

en: We can strike Kanon down!
zh: 我们可以击败卡农！

en: Help me storm the castle， and end his puppet tyranny!
zh: 帮我攻入城堡，终结他的傀儡暴政！

en: Bam! Who just turned your mechs into wrecks? Me. I did.
zh: 砰！谁把你们的机甲打成了废铁？是我，就是我。

en: Next on the list: Kanon. Come on!
zh: 接下来轮到卡农。走吧！

en: I bet that got their attention.
zh: 这下他们该注意到我们了。

en: C'mon! Let's corner Kanon and try to make sense of all this.
zh: 走！堵住卡农，把整件事问个明白。

en: The metal puppets have fallen.
zh: 钢铁傀儡已然倒下。

en: Now， to face the puppet wearing a robe and crown.
zh: 该去会会那披着长袍、戴着王冠的傀儡了。

en: Look at this mess! My tax money!
zh: 看看这一地狼藉！我的税钱啊！

en: C'mon， Goldie， let's make Gramps cough up a refund!
zh: 走，金大个儿，让那老头把钱退回来！

en: Huh!? Back up.
zh: 啊！？等等。

en: The king isn't really king!? You lying son of a cyclops!
zh: 国王不是真国王！？你这个满口胡话的独眼怪崽子！

en: A puppet monarchy!
zh: 原来是傀儡王室！

en: No wonder the people suffer.
zh: 难怪百姓受苦。

en: Hey! What did I miss?
zh: 喂！我错过什么了？

en: What are you talking about?
zh: 你们在说什么？

en: What has gotten into the royal knights?
zh: 王国骑士到底怎么了？

en: They've never attacked the village head on!
zh: 他们从没这样正面进攻村庄啊！

en: Save... the villagers... Nngh...
zh: 救……村民……唔……

en: Rebels never say... dnnnngh...
zh: 叛军永不……呃啊……

en: Once I have you in the air， you will never know the peace of crashing to the ground!
zh: 一旦被我打上天，你就休想安稳落地！

en: I'd stay， were you worth the effort of sharpening my sword.
zh: 要是你值得我磨一回剑，我倒愿意留下。

en: Why stay? Will swatting flies make me stronger?
zh: 何必久留？拍苍蝇能让我变强吗？

en: Weaker than week-old bread!
zh: 比放了一星期的面包还软！

en: Sorry， but the village is kind of under attack， y'know?
zh: 抱歉，村子正挨打呢，你知道吧？

en: You just flopped worse than Nando's ears.
zh: 你耷拉得比南多的耳朵还厉害。

en: Sucks to be you!
zh: 算你倒霉！

en: Keep still. It will hurt less.
zh: 别动，就不会那么疼。

en: Another day， perhaps.
zh: 改日再战吧。

en: Apologies， warriors， but time is of the essence.
zh: 抱歉，各位战士，时间紧迫。

en: Omigosh! I should make a career out of this!
zh: 天哪！我该靠这个吃饭！

en: See my smiley? He's frowning at you.
zh: 看见我的笑脸了吗？它正在对你皱眉呢。

en: Nya ha ha! The jig is up， rebel sympathizers! I knew you were all in cahoots.
zh: 哇哈哈！露馅了吧，你们这帮叛军同党！我就知道你们勾结在一起。

en: You cannot pull the wool over Lord Zur's eyes. Now perish!
zh: 休想蒙蔽祖尔大人的双眼。现在去死吧！

en: Mother bucket! What the heck is that!?
zh: 妈了个桶！那究竟是什么鬼东西！？

en: At last! It's activating! Hear thee， Golem God! I order you to destroy all who  serve the royal bloodline!
zh: 终于！启动了！听令，魔像神！消灭所有效忠王族血脉的人！

en: Mommy... Why do the big creatures always hate me?
zh: 妈妈呀……为什么大块头总跟我过不去？

en: SERVANTS OF THE ROYAL BLOODLINE... DETECTED!
zh: 发现……王族血脉的追随者！

en: Interesting.
zh: 有意思。

en: Hey! Not at us!
zh: 喂！别打我们！

en: Bwa ha ha! That machine knows its bloodlines!
zh: 哇哈哈！这机器可真认得王族血脉！

en: And apparently， so do you.
zh: 看来，你也认得。

en: Bah! Where's the glory in offing some green-armored wimp?
zh: 呸！杀个穿绿甲的废物，有什么值得炫耀的？

en: You nincompoops are the only fugitives that matter. Now get ready for a Zur-prise!
zh: 你们这些笨蛋才是要紧的逃犯。准备领教祖尔大人的惊喜吧！

en: There! I like these odds better! Attack， my pretties!
zh: 这才对！现在胜算好多了！宝贝们，进攻！

en: Have you all lost your mind?
zh: 你们全疯了吗？

en: How dare you lay your hands on me--a national treasure! Lord Kanon will hear of this!
zh: 竟敢对我动手！我可是国宝！这事我一定要告诉卡农大人！

en: Why not go cry to the king?
zh: 怎么不去找国王哭诉？

en: ...Because you know the truth.
zh: ……因为你知道真相。

en: I watched you at the castle. You always had a hand in Kanon's slimiest affairs.
zh: 我在城堡里见过你。卡农那些肮脏勾当，总有你一份。

en: He told you， didn't he?
zh: 他都告诉你了，对吧？

en: That he destroyed the true royal family. That the king we have now is just a puppet--
zh: 是他灭了真正的王室。如今的国王不过是个傀儡——

en: A dictator he put on the throne to seize power!
zh: 一个被他扶上王座、替他攫取权力的独裁者！

en: What!?
zh: 什么！？

en: The king is a fraud?
zh: 国王是个骗子？

en: You... you... you you YOU YOU YOU'RE NOT SUPPOSED TO KNOW THAT!
zh: 你……你……你你你你你不该知道这些！

en: You're just a lowly knight- captain with a... with a big golden freak for a friend!
zh: 你不过是个卑微的骑士团长，身边还带着个……金灿灿的大怪物！

en: Grrr... Hmph! So be it. The gloves are off. Schnitzel is about to get very， very real.
zh: 可恶……哼！好吧，我可不留情了。这下真要闹出大事了。

en: I will punish you as only Lord Zur can...
zh: 我要用祖尔大人独一无二的方式惩罚你们……

en: By disappearing!
zh: 我消失给你们看！

en: Serena， I served in the Blue Order. If the king's not a king， then am I not a knight?
zh: 瑟蕾娜，我曾为蓝之骑士团效力。国王若不是国王，那我也不算骑士了吗？

en: I don't have all the answers.
zh: 我也无法回答所有问题。

en: But I promise you: Kanon will not stop at forcing magic and machinery into our lives.
zh: 但我敢说，卡农绝不会止步于强迫我们接受魔法和机械。

en: He has some higher goal. Something that drives him...
zh: 他还有更大的目的。有某种东西驱使着他……

en: Like I care what makes him tick! He's a liar who's deceived us all.
zh: 谁管他打的什么算盘！他骗了我们所有人。

en: I'll tear down his little puppet show myself.
zh: 我要亲手砸烂他的傀儡戏。

en: Yeowch! What's the big idea?
zh: 哎哟！你搞什么鬼？

en: Stop! We are not the enemy!
zh: 住手！我们不是敌人！

en: Ack! What's it doing? Somebody call tech support!
zh: 啊！它在干什么？快找人来修修！

en: No way! So it's not that the king had a change of heart-- WE had a change of king!
zh: 不会吧！原来不是国王变了心，而是咱们换了个国王！

en: Puppet!? Is that true?
zh: 傀儡！？是真的吗？

en: Time out there， honey.
zh: 等等，亲爱的。

en: The king's a fraud?
zh: 国王是个骗子？

en: So the king is a fake?
zh: 所以国王是假的？

en: I can hardly believe it...
zh: 真让人难以相信……

en: All this time， we've been jerked around by a phony king?
zh: 这么久以来，我们都在被一个假国王耍得团团转？

en: Yeah， it's called insanity!
zh: 没错，他就是疯了！

en: He thinks he can lie to us and get away with it? He can think again! Right， Nando?
zh: 他以为骗了我们还能逍遥自在？做梦！对吧，南多？

en: These are dark times， when demons like him call themselves men. He will pay for deceiving the people!
zh: 妖孽竟敢自称为人，真是世道昏暗。他欺骗百姓，定要付出代价！

en: You know what we need? Someone of true royal blood! They'd know what to do.
zh: 知道我们需要什么吗？真正的王族！他们一定知道该怎么办。

en: Behold! How we burst from our skin-tight suits! Lo! Are our visages not awesomely cute?
zh: 看啊！我们挣脱紧身衣，闪亮登场！瞧！我们的面容是不是可爱得惊人？

en: Wow! It's us!  The kleptomaniacal Glutes!
zh: 哇！正是我们！偷遍天下的翘臀团！

en: Hey. Nice to rob ya.
zh: 嘿，很高兴抢劫你。

en: You buttinskies picked a bad day to crash Macho's turf.
zh: 你们这帮多管闲事的，今天可不该闯进马乔的地盘。

en: Macho demands appeasement in the form of that golden dude! Hand him over.
zh: 马乔要你们交出那个金灿灿的家伙，作为赔礼！

en: Never. He serves the kingdom， not rabble like you!
zh: 休想。他为王国效力，岂会听你们这些地痞的！

en: Ha! Good luck talking the “golden dude“ into it.
zh: 哈！你倒是试着说服那位“金大个儿”啊。

en: Have it your way. But Macho warns you! Peter Piper never picked pectorals like THESE.
zh: 随你的便。不过马乔警告你们！这般胸肌，可不是谁都练得出来的。

en: Wait， boss! Me and the boys'll bump these guys off. Watch!
zh: 等等，老大！我们几个就能干掉他们。看着吧！

en: How dare you send Macho's Glutes down the chute!? Grr...
zh: 竟敢把马乔的翘臀团打得屁滚尿流！？可恶……

en: You wield much strength， but Macho senses you are bullies.
zh: 你们确实很强，可马乔看得出，你们专会欺负人。

en: Boss! It's the royal knights!
zh: 老大！王国骑士来了！

en: Here to set Macho up? Hmph! You can go， trespassers. Your beating will come later!
zh: 想给马乔下套？哼！闯入者，这次放你们走，回头再收拾你们！

en: Macho must stay and pump iron. Pink， knightly iron!
zh: 马乔还得留下来练铁。穿粉红铠甲的骑士铁块！

en: Eep! Macho has decided Macho is too manly to fight girly royal lapdogs. Come， Glutes! Strut away swiftly， that we may rob another day!
zh: 呀！马乔决定了，马乔太有男子气概，不屑跟娘娘腔的王家走狗打架。翘臀团，走！快迈开雄壮的步子，改日再抢！

en: Ha! He wouldn't be caught undead in that outfit!
zh: 哈！就算死了，他也不肯穿你那身衣服！

en: A wise man does not take that which will destroy him.
zh: 智者不会伸手去取足以毁掉自己的东西。

en: Sorry! You're not his type!
zh: 抱歉！你不是他喜欢的类型！

en: Wha-Wha-Wha what what what WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE? Didn't Valgar kill you yet?
zh: 你你你你你你怎么在这里？瓦尔加还没杀掉你们吗？

en: Don't just stand there， my pretties! Death formation!
zh: 宝贝们，别愣着！摆出死亡阵形！

en: Nya ha ha! I suppose you were hoping to pop in on your rebel villager friends?
zh: 哇哈哈！你们是想来探望村里那些叛军朋友吧？

en: Well， too bad! Because I “popped“ them first! They are now bloody cherries on my sundae of glory!
zh: 可惜呀！我已经先“照顾”过他们了！他们的血肉，如今都是我荣耀圣代上的樱桃！

en: My genius plan was to frame those muscly thugs for murder-- WAY TO RUIN IT!
zh: 我本来打算把杀人的罪名栽给那群肌肉混混……全被你们毁了！

en: Now the king looks bad， I look bad--and you're gonna look dead!
zh: 现在国王脸上无光，我也丢脸……而你们要丢命！

en: Are you insane? How dare you strike a member of the court! I am nobility!
zh: 你们疯了吗？竟敢袭击朝臣！我可是贵族！

en: You're a noble liar!
zh: 你是贵得离谱的骗子！

en: You know the truth. I watched you at the castle.
zh: 你知道真相。我在城堡里见过你。

en: You always had a hand in Kanon's slimiest affairs. He told you， didn't he?
zh: 卡农那些肮脏勾当，总有你一份。他都告诉你了，对吧？

en: That he destroyed the true royal family. That the king we have now is a puppet--a dictator he put on the throne to seize power!
zh: 是他灭了真正的王室。如今的国王，不过是被他扶上王座、替他攫取权力的傀儡独裁者！

en: What!? The king is a fraud?
zh: 什么！？国王是个骗子？

en: What? Somebody changed kings on us? But that's... crazy...
zh: 什么？有人偷偷换了国王？可这也……太荒唐了……

en: WHO TOLD YOU THAT!? You're just a knight-captain!
zh: 谁告诉你的！？你不过是个骑士团长！

en: A traitor with a big， ugly， smelly， golden， zombie LOSER  for a friend!
zh: 一个叛徒！还跟又大又丑又臭、金灿灿的废物僵尸做朋友！

en: Ugh， I cannot win. Lord Zur is defeated! Lord Zur will kiss your boots and praise your name!
zh: 唉，我赢不了了。祖尔大人认输了！祖尔大人愿意亲吻你们的靴子，歌颂你们的英名！

en: Pfft， in another lifetime!
zh: 嘁，下辈子吧！

en: So the king's not a king?
zh: 所以国王不是真国王？

en: So the king's a fake?
zh: 所以国王是假的？

en: I can hardly believe it.
zh: 真让人难以相信。

en: It must come as a shock.
zh: 这消息一定让你们很震惊。

en: But Kanon will not stop at forcing magic into our lives.
zh: 但卡农绝不会止步于强迫我们接受魔法。

en: He has some higher goal... something that drives him.
zh: 他还有更大的目的……有某种东西驱使着他。

en: Like I care what makes him tick! He's a liar.
zh: 谁管他打的什么算盘！他就是个骗子。

en: And I'm gonna make him pay.
zh: 我要让他付出代价。

en: Yeah， it's called insanity! He has no right to lie to us.
zh: 没错，他就是疯了！他凭什么骗我们。

en: Me and Nando won't allow it!
zh: 我和南多绝不答应！

en: These are dark times.
zh: 真是世道昏暗。

en: How can demons like him call themselves men? He will pay for deceiving the people!
zh: 妖孽竟敢自称为人？他欺骗百姓，定要付出代价！

en: You know what we need? Someone of true royal blood! They'd know how to fix all this.
zh: 知道我们需要什么吗？真正的王族！他们一定知道怎么收拾这烂摊子。

en: Gotta be at least one of 'em left somewhere， right?
zh: 总该还有一个活着吧？

en: Valgar. We're too late.
zh: 瓦尔加。我们来迟了。

en: That knight!? How did he get here so fast?
zh: 那个骑士！？他怎么这么快就到了？

en: I'm starting to feel like the ham on a knight sandwich.
zh: 我怎么觉得自己成了骑士三明治里的火腿。

en: The black knight... Tremendous. Few could mobilize their forces this quickly.
zh: 黑骑士……了不起。能如此迅速调动兵力的人，屈指可数。

en: An ambush? You can't ambush me! I AMBUSH YOU FIRST!
zh: 埋伏？还想埋伏我？我先埋伏了你！

en: So a common mage's power cannot hold you. No matter.
zh: 看来普通法师的力量困不住你们。无妨。

en: My quarrels， I prefer to settle with blades.
zh: 我更喜欢用刀剑解决恩怨。

en: A shame this fun won't last.
zh: 可惜，这乐子不会持续太久。

en: S-Stand your ground， men! They are lawless weaklings!
zh: 士、士兵们，守住！他们只是些目无法纪的弱者！

en: Hmph. I may have misjudged that monster's strength， but--
zh: 哼，我或许低估了那个怪物的力量，可——

en: Hey， what are you-- Ow! Trample THEM， not me!
zh: 喂，你干什——哎哟！踩他们，别踩我！

en: Enough!
zh: 够了！

en: Come， men!
zh: 士兵们，跟我来！

en: Well well， if it isn't my favorite gaggle of rebel sympathizers.
zh: 哟哟，这不是我最喜欢的那群叛军同党吗？

en: A shame you missed the magic as I ground your co-traitors into hamburgers! But fear not. My powerful golem will ensure that you--wait for it--ketchup.
zh: 可惜你们错过了好戏，没看见我把你们的同党碾成肉饼！别担心，我这强大的魔像马上就来……给你们添点番茄酱！

en: How dare you ruffle my... my royal neck ruffle!
zh: 竟敢弄皱我的……我的王室皱领！

en: This is property of the king!
zh: 这可是国王的财产！

en: Liar!
zh: 骗子！

en: The king is an imposter.
zh: 国王是冒牌货。

en: You always had a hand in Kanon's slimiest affairs.
zh: 卡农那些肮脏勾当，总有你一份。

en: So you know he destroyed the true royal family. The king we have now is a puppet he put on the throne to gain power!
zh: 所以你知道，是他灭了真正的王室。如今的国王，不过是被他扶上王座、替他攫取权力的傀儡！

en: A royal switch?
zh: 王室被掉包了？

en: Puppet!? Surely that can't be true?
zh: 傀儡！？这不可能是真的吧？

en: H-HOW DO YOU KNOW THAT!?
zh: 你、你怎么会知道！？

en: You're just a knight-captain! A traitor with a big golden FREAK for a friend.
zh: 你不过是个骑士团长！一个跟金灿灿大怪物做朋友的叛徒。

en: If you're not going to play fair... then take this! My ultimate weapon--
zh: 你们不肯公平较量……那就接招吧！我的最终绝招——

en: Hyper Dimensional Parallel Extra Strong Super Attack... HOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO! ...HO?
zh: 超次元平行特强超级攻击……喝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！……啊？

en: Ho crap， it's not working.
zh: 啊，该死，没用啊。

en: I don't know the whole story.
zh: 事情的全貌，我也不清楚。

en: He thinks he can lie to us and get away with it? No way!
zh: 他以为骗了我们还能逍遥自在？休想！

en: These warriors...
zh: 这些战士……

en: They died in another age.
zh: 他们死于另一个时代。

en: Was there a war fought here? I don't savor killing men who already gave their life once.
zh: 这里曾发生过战争？我不愿再杀死这些早已献出生命的人。

en: Magic didn't bring these warriors back. Hatred did. You feel that rage in the air?
zh: 唤醒这些战士的不是魔法，而是仇恨。感受到空气中的怒火了吗？

en: I sense agony in this place. These fields were watered with blood. I wonder...
zh: 我能感到此地的苦痛。鲜血曾浸透这片原野。不知……

en: Who were these men?
zh: 他们生前究竟是谁？

en: A war must've been fought here long ago. The souls of the dead are screaming! Either that， or I have a migraine.
zh: 这里很久以前一定打过仗。亡者的灵魂正在尖叫！要不就是我偏头痛了。

en: Rrgh. Here already? It's these ghoulish pests...
zh: 可恶，这么快就追来了？都怪这些不死的害虫……

en: Have the dead no honor， attacking their fellow knights?
zh: 这些死人竟然袭击骑士同袍，还有没有荣誉可言？

en: Fellow knights? No... My ancestors lie here.
zh: 骑士同袍？不……这里长眠着我的先祖。

en: Rest now， kindred spirits. I promise you， the true monarchy you fought for will never be stamped out by the likes of him.
zh: 安息吧，同族的英魂。我向你们保证，你们誓死守护的真正王室，绝不会毁在他这种人手里。

en: I'm starting to understand...
zh: 我开始明白了……

en: This must be where the true royal family lies buried.
zh: 这里一定是真正王族的埋骨之地。

en: Ohhh. I get it now.
zh: 哦……我懂了。

en: This is where the real royalty was buried.
zh: 真正的王族就葬在这里。

en: You question their honor， but I know it to be real.
zh: 你质疑他们的荣誉，可我知道，那是真正的荣誉。

en: These warriors died in defense of the true monarchy.
zh: 这些战士是为保卫真正的王室而死。

en: Well， wouldn't you be ticked off if a bunch of impostors came along and stole your king's throne?
zh: 换成你，有一群冒牌货来抢了你国王的王位，你不生气？

en: What?
zh: 什么？

en: You're speaking nonsense.
zh: 一派胡言。

en: Huh? Something's...
zh: 嗯？好像有什么……

en: Ah! Feel that hatred! This warrior is unlike any we have faced!
zh: 啊！好深的恨意！这战士与我们以往的敌人都不同！

en: A captain? No， a general!
zh: 团长？不，是将军！

en: Whoever he was， he's on nobody's side now.
zh: 无论他生前是谁，如今都不站在任何一边。

en: Oh my grog. N-Nando， did you just wet yourself?
zh: 我的老天。南、南多，你刚才是不是吓尿了？
